guide.summary: A tiny, very fast hunter that darts after bacteria but burns through its energy quickly.
guide.biology: Some real single-celled swimmers whip a long tail to dash through the water and snap up bacteria.
guide.rules: Lives in water. Moves 3 cells per second and notices prey up to 5 cells away. Catches one prey on contact, stores it as a meal of up to twice its own body, and waits 2 seconds before the next catch. Stops hunting when well fed. Eats Sprinter, Dusk, Recycler, Crossfeeder, Crumbsmith, Oilwick, Brothmaker, Lantern, Brinecoil, Sourbud and Sleeper, attached or not; never Velvet or Rampart. Uses 1.0 energy per second just to stay alive, plus the cost of all that swimming. Small enough to pass through a small gate. Prey for Needlejaw.
guide.example: Put a small gate between a Dartfin group and a Sprinter patch and watch whether the Dartfins slip through to hunt.
